dedupeText: country music album cover design 90s country aesthetic ribbed sweater warm lighting distressed serif wide tracking sans serif masculine portrait the purple hue of the sweater provides a cool toned focal point against the warm wood and skin tones the top heavy distressed typography balances the weight of the subject s arms in the foreground the horizontal line of the subtitle cuts across the chest creating a structural anchor for the composition combine a masculine warm toned portrait with a dual font system one heavy distressed for the name and one light wide tracked for the message

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a man with a mustache sitting on wooden steps, featuring a high-contrast warm lighting scheme and a dual-typographic layout consisting of a distressed display serif and a clean, wide-spaced sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: The purple hue of the sweater provides a cool-toned focal point against the warm wood and skin tones.
The top-heavy distressed typography balances the weight of the subject's arms in the foreground.
The horizontal line of the subtitle cuts across the chest, creating a structural anchor for the composition.
coreInvariants: Warm, directional lighting from the top-right creating deep shadows.
Symmetrical seated pose with hands clasped between knees.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame, seated on a diagonal wooden staircase.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white distressed title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright title at the top, down to the face, across the subtitle, and following the arms to the clasped hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas in the upper corners and lower background provide depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers from the wooden environment and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted lavender-purple of the shirt acting as a primary visual break.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography to ensure maximum legibility against dark backgrounds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the lit skin/shirt and the deep black shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy slab-serif and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick strokes with irregular, eroded edges to simulate a stamped or weathered effect.
Subtitle text uses uniform stroke weight with open apertures and wide letter spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded terminals on the serif font to suggest age or grit.
Extreme tracking on the sans-serif to create a modern, airy contrast.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of a heavy, textured serif with a light, clean, widely-spaced sans-serif.

preserve: Distressed texture of the top font
Wide tracking of the middle font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure with weathered edges.
Provides the clean geometric skeleton for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a mustache and short hair, wearing a lavender ribbed short-sleeve sweater. He is sitting on wooden stairs in a warm, dimly lit room. The lighting should be directional, coming from the top right, creating strong highlights on his face and arms while leaving the background in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, distressed slab-serif font at the top center. Add a subtitle in a smaller, all-caps, clean geometric sans-serif font with wide tracking, positioned horizontally across the center of the man's chest.

verificationChecks: Is the top font visibly weathered/eroded?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the width of the torso?
Does the purple sweater stand out against the warm wood tones?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the distressed texture on the title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Check that the distressed effect doesn't make the title unreadable.
Verify the lighting consistency across the subject and the stairs.
Confirm the wide tracking of the subtitle is uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a masculine, warm-toned portrait with a dual-font system: one heavy/distressed for the name and one light/wide-tracked for the message.
